classes.how: the class Generation 3 Evolved's ROM gives the same Pokémon, matched by national dex number

chart.source: the 18 x 18 table of bytes in the battle engine (overlay 14, 0x0224DA40): [attacking][defending], 4 = normal

10.desc: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move.

11.desc: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move.

18.desc: Draws in Fire moves: no damage, ups Sp. Atk.

26.desc: Gives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

31.desc: Draws in Electric moves: no damage, ups Sp. Atk.

47.desc: Ups resistance to Fire-and Ice-type moves.

78.desc: Raises Speed if hit by an Electric-type move.

85.desc: Weakens the power of Fire-type moves.

87.desc: Reduces HP if it is hot. Rain restores HP.

114.desc: Draws in Water moves: no damage, ups Sp. Atk.

157.desc: Immune to Grass moves, which raise its Attack.

199.desc: Weakens Fire moves on it and prevents burns.

218.desc: Halves contact damage, but Fire hurts it more.

272.desc: Salt blocks status; Ghost damage is halved.

273.desc: Fire moves do no damage and sharply up Defense.

297.desc: Ground moves heal it instead of hurting it.
